Row-44 source/weight assessment passes; this is not task clearance. All task paths below are under .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r3/task/. The actual workbook Quality Checks!C45:D45 requires real functionality to outweigh structure/style; Internal Quality Checks!E45 explicitly describes the 60 percent functionality share. tests/scoring.toml:6-8 has functional=0.6, polish=0.2, visual=0.2 and is byte-identical to the frozen template (both SHA256 95f70d6e06aae5e765b2309d88c444aa36d4cd82763ea2212781b6a99311bbba). The nominal non-functional maximum is 0.4; actual visual craft is 0.2 because every Polish row proves stateful refusal/retry recovery requested by instruction.md. Functional has 145 outcome criteria with total weight exactly45: ordinary-desk criteria sum17 (maximum overall contribution0.2266667), coordinated-change criteria sum28 (0.3733333). Thus the defining coordinated workflow has the majority of functional mass. Critical transaction outcomes have weights1.6 or2 (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:933,951,1050,1077,1086: net budgets, lineage, ABA freshness, identical retries, overlap atomicity), versus0.01 for simple roster/intake/conditional draft observations (lines186,510,672). These weights track substantive outcomes, not source structure or naming. Polish weights1.5/1.5/0.5/2.5/3 total9; coordinated recovery and uncertain-result continuity receive6/9 of that dimension (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:18-61). Visual has five distinct equally weighted anchored craft properties, each maximum0.04 overall (tests/scored/visual/judge.toml:18-90).

Executed python -B qc/runs/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r3/per-row-review/evidence/44/inspect_weights.py. It invoked the unchanged frozen score.py on synthetic dimension records: all Functional alone returns0.6, all Functional+Polish without Visual returns0.8, visual-only returns0, F=0.05/P=1/V=1 returns0, and F=0.051/P=1/V=1 returns0.4306. These demonstrate the formula and strict functional floor in tests/tools/score.py:46-48, not achieved app scores. The above-floor case is an algebraic upper bound; full Polish cannot be earned by a dead app because successful preparation/commit/recovery controls are required. Broken alternative considered: an attractive fully working ordinary offer desk with no coordinated-change functionality could earn, optimistically, ordinary Functional17/45, ordinary Polish3/9 and Visual1, yielding synthetic0.4933, below all Functional alone0.6. A static/no-op attractive shell additionally fails the live creation/readback gate. Conforming alternative considered: an initially empty operational desk with generated identities, different screen layout and exact financial/recovery behavior receives the same outcome weights; optional historical DRAFT omission is explicitly accepted at functional line672, while visual prompts forbid screenshot/layout matching. No row-44 weight defect was demonstrated.
